question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Up in arms
solution:
The correct answer is **Option (3) i.e. "Ready to fight"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• "Up in arms": (लड़ने के लिए तैयार) - To be very angry and ready to fight, protest, or take action against something.
 
• Example: The workers were up in arms over the proposed pay cuts.
